thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: service=redwood-redis-prod alert=fired severity=critical — redis-cluster-prod maxclients >= 95% for 3m
PagerDuty: Incident opened, alert id PD-48321, paging primary oncall.
Sara D: seeing 5xxs from API gateway, any idea?
Mike L: yep getting an uptick in 503s, looks correlated with redis errors in logs.
Anya R: pinging metrics — redis client connections at 98%, blocked clients rising.
Oliver K: stack traces show a lot of KV cache misses, then burst of connections from embedding workers.
Keiko (oncall): acked PD-48321. I'm on it, taking first touch.
CS-Bot: Heads-up: CS dashboard shows several enterprise customers reporting timeouts on sync endpoints.
Keiko (oncall): thanks, tagging @Anya @Mike. Initial plan: enable degraded-mode flag for low-priority traffic, and scale redis-replicas if needed.
Mike L: can we flip the feature flag for embeddings-heavy routes to fallback to async? that should drop peak connections.
Anya R: feature flag toggle ready, but need confirmation on rollback steps.
Keiko (oncall): rollback = flip flag off + confirm connection drop in 2m, will alert if not.
Oliver K: Redis INFO shows maxclients=10000, connected_clients=9850, blocked_clients=120. A few clients have long-lived pipelines.
Mike L: which pools? app-embed-worker and realtime-batcher. batching policy changed yesterday, might be causing longer lifetimes.
Sara D: rolling back batching change on realtime-batcher in k8s?
Mike L: yes, I'll roll the deployment for realtime-batcher to previous image (tag v2.3.1).
Keiko (oncall): doing feature-flag toggle now -> `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"degrade_embeddings","value":true}'`
incident-bot: feature flag degrade_embeddings set to true by keiko at 2024-04-22T16:10:12Z
Anya R: seeing immediate drop in new connection churn, connected_clients down to 9700. Blocked_clients falling.
Oliver K: good. still some long-lived connections from two ip ranges — looks like a misbehaving batch job.
Mike L: I've started rollout of rollback image for realtime-batcher: `kubectl set image deploy/realtime-batcher realtime-batcher=registry:v2.3.1`
PagerDuty: escalation policy notified secondary oncall (Anya R) due to no-resolve in 5m.
Anya R: taking over. I'm going to cordon the problematic nodes hosting the batch jobs to force graceful reconnects.
Keiko (oncall): I've opened a short-term mitigation: increased redis maxclients to 12000 on the 3 primaries (config change applied).
Oliver K: careful — raising maxclients needs memory headroom check. we've got ~30% free. ok with the change for now.
CS-Bot: Notifying top 3 impacted accounts via templated message; CS lead assigned: Jaime.
Sara D: error-rate for /v1/embed batch endpoints dropped from 14% -> 4% in last 7min. latency still elevated for some tenants.
Mike L: rollout completed. reloads caused reconnects — connections stabilized.
Anya R: confirming: connected_clients 8400, blocked_clients 5. Redis latency p95 back to normal.
Keiko (oncall): moving to stabilize mode. will monitor for 30m before handing off. PD incident status -> acknowledged -> status: mitigated.
incident-bot: PD-48321 acknowledged by keiko, mitigated by runbook steps (feature-flag degrade + rollback batch change + bump maxclients).
PagerDuty: Incident resolved by Anya R at 2024-04-22T16:30:00Z (notes: temporary degrade flag + rollback; follow-up: root cause analysis).
Sara D: customer impact summary for RCA: transient 10-15% 5xxs for embed batch endpoints across 12 tenants for ~20min; no data loss.
Anya R: follow-ups: (1) revert temporary maxclients bump after cool-down, (2) add circuit-breaker to embed workers, (3) add per-tenant rate limiting for batch embed endpoints, (4) postmortem scheduled.
Keiko (oncall): I'm starting a handoff note in #incidents and scheduling 1hr RCA with infra and eng-ml. Thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
Mike L: +1, will create PR with batching change rework and test harness for connection lifetime.
Oliver K: will add metric alert for pipeline duration to catch long-lived clients earlier.
CS-Bot: Logged customer-impact tickets for affected accounts, CS lead Jaime will follow up with status updates.
Keiko (oncall): handing off to Anya for post-incident follow-up. leaving channel.
Anya R: acknowleged handoff, will own RCA action items. closing the thread once RCA doc posted. :white_check_mark:
